verdict_reason: Contact-address scenarios are removed, but the role-scoped one-page picker rules are replaced with a paged whole-book design the code does not implement.

todos.issue: Beyond removing the contact address, the PR rewrites the role picker back to an older paged, whole-book design that the code does not have: it deletes REQ-ADDR-018 (each role's list holds only that role's addresses plus role-less ones) and REQ-ADDR-017 (every address on one page), adds REQ-ADDR-010 (paging, line 275), and rewords REQ-ADDR-006 (line 179, 'search the whole address book'), SCN-ADDR-006-B (190, 'paginated as before'), SCN-ADDR-007-C (228), SCN-ADDR-009-B (263, 'moved to a later page') and REQ-ADDR-011/SCN-ADDR-011-A/B (285-297, 'opens on its first page... naming the address'). The animals frontend at 08f4558 lists by role with no page parameter (party-picker.controller.js:53-55: addressBook.addresses(orgId, { query, role: party.addressBookRole })), and the frontend PR does not touch the picker. None of this is in the EUDPA-776 AC.
todos.fix: Must: the addresses spec describes the role-scoped, one-page, checked-row picker the code has, as on main, with only the consignment contact removed (from REQ-ADDR-018's title and text, SCN-ADDR-018-C/D, SCN-ADDR-001-B/D/K/L/M, REQ-ADDR-002 and REQ-ADDR-014). One way: restore the file from origin/main and redo only the contact-address deletions; do the same for openspec/coverage/live-animals/addresses/coverage.json (+901/-220).
